howe_sound.label: Howe Sound
howe_sound.text: >Marine Forecast Issued 04:00 PM PDT 23 August 2026 Tonight and Monday. Strong wind warning in effect. Wind southerly inflow 10 to 20 knots except southwesterly inflow 25 over northern sections. Wind diminishing to light this evening then increasing to northerly outflow 10 to 20 near midnight. Wind becoming southerly inflow 10 to 20 near noon Monday. Showers ending this evening.
